summary: 11 film announcements, 9 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Wreckless
film.talent: Alexa Swinton, David Arquette, Wyatt Oleff, Sawyer Spielberg
film.announcement: Demolition derby drama from first-time feature filmmaker Kayla Arend sets cast with Swinton, Arquette, Oleff, and Spielberg.

film.title: The Ballad of the Ember Knight
film.announcement: Sony pre-empts 14th century-set spec script by first-time writers for near seven-figure deal.

film.title: Scapegoat
film.announcement: Jacob Elordi in talks to star alongside Scarlett Johansson in Ari Aster's next film at A24.

film.title: Stag Dance
film.announcement: Run-A-Muck developing an adaptation of Torrey Peters' novella 'Stag Dance,' which is part of a 2026 Pulitzer Prize finalist collection.

film.title: Nice Eggs
film.announcement: Coming-of-age drama starring Jane Krakowski and Angourie Rice from director Amanda Lipitz.

film.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
film.announcement: Samuel Goldwyn acquires North America rights to WestEnd Films' holiday comedy from foreign distributor.

film.title: Ink
film.announcement: Netflix sets U.S. release date for Danny Boyle's tabloid drama 'Ink' and unveils first look at Guy Pearce as Rupert Murdoch.

film.title: Yesteryear
film.announcement: Anne Hathaway to star in an adaptation of the hit novel 'Yesteryear.'

film.title: Paper Tiger
film.talent: Adam Driver, Miles Teller, Scarlett Johansson
film.announcement: James Gray's NYC drama 'Paper Tiger' stars Adam Driver and Miles Teller as brothers in this thriller.

film.title: Rivals of Amziah King
film.announcement: Matthew McConaughey returns to acting in indie film 'Rivals of Amziah King' from director Andrew Patterson.

film.title: Tony
film.announcement: Anthony Bourdain biopic 'Tony' was dreamed up at the late chef's favorite dive bar from his youth.

tv.title: Ascension
tv.announcement: Alfonso Cuarón's psychological horror thriller series ordered at Apple TV with Caitriona Balfe starring.

tv.title: St. Denis Medical
tv.announcement: Damon Wayans guest stars on season 3 premiere in 'In Living Color' reunion with David Alan Grier.

tv.title: Alex Cary Thriller
tv.announcement: Louisa Krause joins Dakota Fanning in Apple TV's untitled Alex Cary thriller series.

tv.title: The Sticks
tv.talent: Michelle Monaghan, Scott Bakula, Logan Marshall-Green
tv.announcement: Netflix's YA hockey drama 'The Sticks' confirms cast including Michelle Monaghan, Scott Bakula, and Logan Marshall-Green.

tv.title: Monsterverse Series
tv.talent: Wyatt Russell, Connie Nielsen, Stana Katic
tv.announcement: Connie Nielsen and Stana Katic join Wyatt Russell-led Monsterverse series for Apple TV.

tv.title: Dig
tv.announcement: Peacock drops first look at Hugh Laurie and Amy Poehler in comedy series 'Dig' from Mike Schur and J.J. Philbin.

tv.title: Heated Rivalry
tv.announcement: Justice Smith cast as Harris Drover in series adaptation of 'Heated Rivalry,' promises to take good care of the character.

tv.title: Ted Lasso
tv.announcement: Tanya Reynolds joins season 4 as a 'tough' and 'cold' women's soccer coach.

tv.title: American Hostage
tv.announcement: Jon Hamm faces tense standoff in trailer for 'American Hostage' series.
